name: IdentityField
summary: The database key, carried on the object, so that an object in memory and a row in a table can be matched.

roles.name: IdentityField
roles.summary: The field or property holding the row's key. It is the one piece of the database that a domain object legitimately carries, and saying which member it is matters: it must not be treated as part of the model's meaning — two objects are not equal because a mapper has not yet assigned one of them a key.
